title: tanacetum griffithii
intro: Tanacetum griffithii, commonly known as Griffith's tansy, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for treating digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum griffithii are primarily attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve flatulence, as well as its antispasmodic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Tanacetum griffithii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
